body.statement: Classify \(\mathcal S(\eta,h)\) outside the stable-singleton restriction. Either establish uniqueness and separation, or enumerate every genuine separated tie and derive a measurable next-order selection functional of the complete nuisance-drift path and the coefficient-indexed limiting noise process. The classification must include opposite admissible \(m^{-1/4}\) drifts toward a tie.
body.justification: Global selection is the irreducible open content because deterministic uniform convergence cannot choose between separated equal minima.
body.gap: Neither coefficient profiling nor spiked-matrix edge theory supplies a measurable selector at a drift-sensitive tie of this endogenous scalar potential.
body.consumer: The answer determines whether the abstract full-sample coefficient has a stable limit at every detectability boundary.
